provenance: NOT LIVE: no hook has received these payloads, because a hook on Codex runs only after a person trusts it. The hook fields and the tool names come from the source of Codex rust-v0.166.0: codex-rs/hooks/src/schema.rs (PreToolUseCommandInput, PostToolUseCommandInput) and codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/mcp.rs (hook_tool_name, post_tool_use_payload). The tool_response body is what a live `codex exec --json` on 0.166.0 returned for linear.get_workspace on 2026-11-05, with the values replaced. Its event named server codex_apps and tool linear.get_workspace, which is the route these payloads stand for.
